newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TENNIS-GRAF PULLS OUT OF EUROPEAN INDOOR TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-GRAF PULLS OUT OF EUROPEAN INDOOR TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Steffi Graf on Tuesday pulled out of next week's European indoor championship because of a knee injury.
Graf sustained the injury during a tournament in Leipzig last week and withdrew just hours before she was due to face fellow German Anke Huber in the semifinals.
The joint world number one said then that a tendon strain in her left knee had troubled her since her quarter-final win over Austrian Judith Wiesner.
It is the fourth consecutive year in which Graf has withdrawn from the $1 million Zurich tournament.
Monica Seles, who shares the world number one ranking with the German, withdrew earlier because of nagging shoulder injury and knee problems.
